description: This PHP class 'Transaction' is a controller responsible for handling the process of sending transaction-related emails to customers within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It loads necessary models, retrieves customer and store information, prepares email content, and schedules email sending tasks.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the sending of transaction notification emails to customers.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to prepare and queue the transaction email to be sent to a customer, including gathering customer and store data, localizing content, and scheduling the email task.
